title: land runs as one job across its merge request: the job waits as waiting-merge without holding a slot or the landing lock, and finishes with the second pass
goal: kj_land.drive(job, run_pass, merged, sleep, post) runs a land job as one job: the first pass is bl_land's land ID --wait-merge 0; when it pushed a code branch its pending (shas, branch) is read with bl_land.pending_merge(root, iid), the job moves to waiting-merge with the branch in the event, the executor's slot and the landing lock are free while it polls merged_on_main every 60 s for up to the wait_merge option (default 1800 s), and when the shas are on the integration main the job moves back to running for the second pass (land ID --wait-merge 0 again, which finishes the item as a content landing) and ends succeeded; a wait that runs out ends refused with step wait-merge and the text land says today (merge it with backlog.py merge ID, then submit again); the job never merges the request itself; a job found in waiting-merge after an executor restart (ST-5cqlfweg) polls again from its recorded pending without running the first pass again; a content landing is one pass and never waits

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import kj_land; ev=[]; calls=iter([False,False,True]); r=kj_land.drive({"job":"JB-x","subject":"ST-1","options":{"wait_merge":600}}, run_pass=lambda second: (0,"ok",None) if second else (0,"pushed code/ST-1",(["abc"],"code/ST-1")), merged=lambda shas: next(calls), sleep=lambda s: ev.append(("sleep",s)), post=lambda state,**f: ev.append((state,f.get("step")))); st=[e[0] for e in ev if e[0]!="sleep"]; assert st==["running","waiting-merge","running","succeeded"], ev; assert sum(1 for e in ev if e[0]=="sleep")==2, ev; assert r==(0,"succeeded"), r
